title: Prisma AIRS Scan
description: Scans LLM, REST, and MCP request and response payloads with the Prisma AIRS Runtime API and allows or blocks on the scan verdict.

airsService.title: Prisma AIRS Service
airsService.description: Prisma AIRS Runtime API origin. The policy calls this service directly.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: Prisma AIRS API key, sent as x-pan-token. Use $PRISMA_AIRS_API_KEY in local mode when the gateway substitutes environment variables.

profileName.title: Profile Name
profileName.description: AI security profile name. Leave empty only when profileId is set.

profileId.title: Profile ID
profileId.description: AI security profile ID. Used with or instead of profileName.

scanPath.title: Scan Path
scanPath.description: Synchronous scan path on the Prisma AIRS service.

scanRequests.title: Scan Requests
scanRequests.description: Scan inbound request payloads before they reach the upstream API.

scanResponses.title: Scan Responses
scanResponses.description: Scan upstream response payloads before they reach the caller.

scanLlm.title: Scan LLM Traffic
scanLlm.description: Scan OpenAI and Anthropic chat payloads. Recognized payloads use native schema scanning.

scanRest.title: Scan REST Traffic
scanRest.description: Scan other textual REST request and response bodies.

scanMcp.title: Scan MCP Traffic
scanMcp.description: Scan Model Context Protocol JSON-RPC and /mcp traffic.

failClosed.title: Fail Closed
failClosed.description: Block the exchange when the Prisma AIRS scan call fails or returns no verdict.

blockUnscannable.title: Block Unscannable Payloads
blockUnscannable.description: Block binary payloads. When false, binary payloads are allowed and marked skipped.

blockStatusCode.title: Block Status Code
blockStatusCode.description: HTTP status returned when Prisma AIRS action is block.

timeoutMs.title: Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Timeout for the synchronous scan call, in milliseconds.

userHeader.title: User Header
userHeader.description: Request header copied into Prisma AIRS metadata app_user.

appName.title: Application Name
appName.description: Application name copied into Prisma AIRS metadata app_name.
